title: Work Map Autofix registry refresh scope convergence

phases.objective: Keep the sole governed Work Map writer aligned with the validator when Work Map registry or policy surfaces change, while preserving bounded write authority and fail-closed manifest eligibility.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: The regression test reads the Spec Kit Work Map Autofix workflow from the exact repository checkout.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Registry-affecting changes expand the writer refresh set to the same execution-ready Work Map manifests validated by the gate; ordinary pull requests remain diff-scoped, invalid manifest states fail closed, and remote writes remain bounded.
steps: Inspect the Work Map Autofix workflow without dispatching it.
Require registry-refresh expansion to be conditional on the same Work Map registry or policy change class used by validation.
Require the refresh inventory to include only execution-ready manifests and reject invalid or ambiguous review states.
Require the effective writer set to be the bounded union of target-derived bindings and registry-refresh bindings.
Require write, staging, and verification loops to consume the same bounded writer inventory.
Fail the regression if the writer returns to PR-diff-only scope for registry-affecting changes or broadens to arbitrary repository paths.
assertions: Registry-refresh scope expansion is conditional and is not enabled for unrelated pull requests.
Only canonical execution-ready Work Map integration manifests can enter the registry-refresh set.
Invalid or unsupported manifest states fail closed before writer authority is consumed.
The writer allowlist accepts only target-derived or registry-refresh bindings that passed bounded classification.
Write, staging, currentness, and verification phases share the same effective writer inventory.
No protected-ref mutation, force push, deployment, migration, provider mutation, database write, credential read, or Production mutation is authorized by this contract.

phases.objective: Confirm the next governed registry-affecting Work Map repair converges every validator-selected ready manifest in one exact-head writer cycle without scope broadening.
